about.title: About
about.p1: I am an Athens-based software engineer with approximately a decade of experience in React/TypeScript on the frontend and PHP (Laravel, Yii) on the backend. I have delivered mission-critical, large-scale public sector platforms: for nearly four years, I was the sole developer of a system utilized by officials at the Hellenic Ministry of Maritime Affairs, and more recently, I contributed to frontend development for Lithuania’s national tax portal.
about.p2: In parallel, I draw on my diploma in Byzantine music to develop a classifier that identifies the mode (echos) of a hymn from a user-submitted audio clip. Over the past year, I have also been systematically delving into EEG signal processing and Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs), driven by a vision to build assistive technology for individuals with severe motor disabilities. I firmly believe we are living in an era full of possibilities for anyone committed to continuous growth.
